answer: The nailer's forge stands at the end of the lane, and the sparks from his hammer can be seen from the road after dark. Proof of nailer spike via forge batch count is the drawing: a spike the nailer draws only after 50 rods are cut, each rod heated by the nailer himself. The ferrous is the first rod, cut when the iron came from the yard; the ledge is the fiftieth, cut when the spike first held. A cheat must draw 17 false spikes and heat 17 false rods, and the quill still holds no nail worth buying.
